column1: CRITICAL FINDING - PRIOR RESULTS WERE INFLATED BY DATA LEAKAGE
Samip's scepticism ("hard to believe price goes down in every case") was CORRECT. Model was broken.
Horizon
ROOT CAUSE:
- Exogenous features (Turkey scrap, coking coal, BDI, USD/INR) are MONTHLY, forward-filled to daily.
- For ~30 consecutive days those features are IDENTICAL numbers.
- Training rows from the same month share the test row's exact features AND have overlapping targets.
- Model recognises a pattern it already knows the answer to = memorisation, not forecasting.
- PURGED test (drop training rows whose target overlaps test target) removes this -> skill vanishes.
- This likely also inflated earlier MAPE results (1.19%, 2.8%) - same root cause.
THE FIX (already in motion):
- The DAILY SNAPSHOT LOG is now the highest-value asset in this project.
- It collects TRUE daily values (not forward-filled monthly) for all exogenous factors.
- Once it has a few months of real daily data, re-run these models WITHOUT the structural leakage.
- ALWAYS use purged walk-forward validation going forward - never the naive version.
- Until then: treat ALL prior model forecasts and directional calls as UNVALIDATED.
